content.text: Perfect! Now let me create a summary of all the output files:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && ls -lh *.tsv *.txt *.py *.sh *.md 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $9, "(" $5 ")"}' && echo "" && echo "COMPLETE FILE LIST:" && find . -type f \( -name "*.tsv" -o -name "*.txt" -o -name "*.py" -o -name "*.sh" -o -name "*.md" \) -exec ls -lh {} \; | awk '{printf "%-40s %8s\n", $9, $5}'
input.description: List all output files with sizes
